name: Lucas Martin
headline: Staff Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer with 9 years building fast, accessible web products for media and travel. I care about design systems, performance budgets and helping product teams ship with confidence.

experience.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
bullets: Lead the move of four news sites from a legacy templating front end to Next.js, serving 9 million monthly readers.
Raised Core Web Vitals to 'good' on 92% of pages by moving rendering to the server and cutting the TypeScript bundle by 38%.
Built the shared design system in Storybook, now used by 11 teams and 140 components.
Set up Jest unit and snapshot suites that run on every pull request.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
bullets: Rebuilt the flight search and booking flow in React and TypeScript, lifting mobile conversion by 14%.
Replaced ad-hoc state handling with Redux Toolkit across the checkout, removing a class of double-booking bugs.
Introduced Jest component tests and raised front-end coverage from 20% to 75%.
Mentored three junior developers through their first year on the team.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Built marketing and e-commerce sites for agency clients in React and plain JavaScript.
Turned designers' mock-ups into responsive HTML and CSS that met WCAG AA.
Cut average page weight by half by introducing image pipelines and lazy loading.
